title: Tiny Dent
subtitle: A procedural sandbox where you reshape small planets, by hand or through autonomous robots, and watch the residents decide whether they like what you did.

decision.question: What should the player's main verb be?

rejected.option: Dig the planet by hand, Astroneer-style
rejected.why: The world only changes as fast as the player clicks, and repeated manual digging hides the procedural systems underneath

chosen.option: Delegate to robots that follow visible rules
chosen.why: The player sets goals and work areas; the interesting part becomes how the planet and its residents respond
